newsitem.title: FRANCE: Degremont falls on gloomy forecast.
newsitem.headline: Degremont falls on gloomy forecast.

text.p: Shares in Lyonnaise des Eaux unit Degremont fell sharply on Monday after chairman Olivier Kreiss said in an interview that he expected a drop in 1996 profit and that he did not see a buyout by Lyonnaise soon.
Degremont shares were down 5.06 percent at 413 francs at 1115 GMT. The bourse's CAC-40 index was 0.32 percent higher.

Kreiss said in an interview with the weekly Journal des Finances that although Degremont's 1997 result would be higher, it would probably not match the 1995 level, when the water treatment firm reported net attributable profit of 154.5 million francs.
Asked whether he expected Lyonnaise to launch a buyout as it did last November for its Elyo unit, Kreiss said it did not appear to be in the cards.
